{{Top|leg}}
'''Fusion rockets''' were a type of heavy ordnance used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Several of these rockets impacted into an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator assault ship]] during the fighting, barely scoring its [[Neutronium/Legends|neutronium]] hull cladding.
